title: Module 1 — The Science of Sfumato
subtitle: Smoke between light and dark
learning_objectives: Define sfumato without confusing it with simple blur
Identify at least three value steps on a soft edge
Practice one silhouette without a hard contour line

sections.title: Watch
sections.body: Watch the preview lecture. Note where the edge dissolves into atmosphere instead of stopping with a line.

sections.title: Theory
sections.body: Sfumato is graduated absence of hard contour so form emerges from air. Value transitions do the drawing. On a cheek, seek three values rather than a binary light/dark split — the middle value carries the sfumato.

sections.title: Studio practice
sections.body: Pick a simple silhouette (sphere, cheek, or cloud). Block light, middle, dark. Soften only the transition zone — leave structure under the softness.

sections.title: Reflect
sections.body: Where did you still draw a hard line out of habit? What would three values change there?

key_terms.def: Soft transitions where contour dissolves into air
Relative lightness or darkness of a plane
Edge that separates form from ground
